copy.tagline: 拼接视频片段并调整导出参数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用ffmpeg拼接视频并添加转场和音频
copy.tagline_en: Stitch video segments with transitions and audio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to concatenate videos with ffmpeg and add transitions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 ffmpeg 拼接视频片段、添加转场、叠加画面、混入音频，并设置导出参数。
howto.when: 当你提供视频拼接需求或源文件路径，并给出品牌、产品、平台等约束时触发。

say.text: 把这两个视频片段拼接成一个，中间加淡入淡出效果。
给这段视频叠加一个 logo 图片，并混入背景音乐。
say.note: Claude 会使用 overlay 和音频混合功能。

say.text: 将三段视频按顺序合并，输出为 1080p 30fps 的 MP4。
say.note: Claude 会使用 concat 协议并设置导出参数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can stitch video segments using ffmpeg concat, xfade, overlay, audio mux, and export settings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a video stitching request or source asset path, along with brand, product, platform, and other constraints.

say_en.text: Stitch these two video clips together with a crossfade transition.
say_en.note: Claude will use ffmpeg's xfade filter.

say_en.text: Overlay a logo image on this video and mix in background music.
say_en.note: Claude will use overlay and audio mux.

say_en.text: Concatenate three video segments and export as 1080p 30fps MP4.
say_en.note: Claude will use concat protocol and export settings.
